acceptance_criteria: Exact momentum conservation, left-arrow and chiral Ward endpoint on the actual seed, including dual weak representation.
Two nonzero rational off-shell cases, one on-shell left-fermion row after amputation, and matrix element equality at zero tolerance.
Wrong arrow, crossing, order, projector, and unconverted weak action fail; the inverse term can only be removed after the on-shell row projection.
Fresh byte-identical run on topic base and actual source-control, standards, and native I/O provenance.
No claim about whole external-leg sum, full LSZ, Ward/STI, or integrated matching.
